Title: Improve your English writing
NewsSummary: English writing courses and services at AKU
NewsContent:
The Network of English Language Enhancement (ELE_net) offers a range of courses and services aimed at improving your writing skills in English. Course participants enrol online and receive expert feedback on their writing submissions from their tutor.

Writing Feedback Service

The aim of the Writing Feedback Service is to provide students, staff and faculty at AKU with expert feedback and help develop your use of English language for writing. An ELE_net Writing Advisor will provide feedback on the strengths and weaknesses of your writing and give guidance on language - range, accuracy and appropriateness. Staff member Qayam Suchwani explains how the service met his needs. “My manager advised me to contact ELE_net about improving my writing skills. I first submitted my written work at their Writing Feedback Service, which is available on the AKU VLE for free. A detailed feedback was then provided with recommendations as to how I can improve various aspects of my writing. The process is simple and I found ELE_net to be very professional..”

Language Accuracy in Writing Blended

The first Language Accuracy in Writing Blended course was completed recently by students in Tanzania. This course, one of three academic writing courses offered by ELE_net, aims to provide students with the opportunity to develop accuracy in academic writing. Students were exposed to and practised elements of language that are essential for writing clear and accurate academic texts. Students provided positive feedback, commenting that "the activities in the course reflected the experiences we were going through in our current writing, and what we are supposed to do in our academic papers". The Language Accuracy in Writing course is also offered online for students in all AKU campuses.

Writing

This online course is available for staff working at any campus at AKU. We currently have course participants enrolled from different departments, meeting together in weekly webinars with their tutor and practising writing tasks relevant to their roles. Individual feedback is provided with the aim of helping staff learn to write correctly, clearly and concisely. If you struggle to write clearly and concisely or make frequent grammar mistakes, then this eight-week writing course will help increase your skills and boost your confidence.
